purpose: Vehicle-scoped completed-week efficiency goal workspace using the observed, capped drive-history window.
primaryGoal: Set a persisted consumption target and compare completed-week results, active-week observations, consistency, weekday patterns, recent ranking and coverage without implying lifetime completeness.

dataSources.name: useDriveHistory
dataSources.routeEvidence: internal\api\router.go:3463-3464 groups /drives with GET / mapped to driveHandler.ListByVehicle; HTTP slash normalization was not exercised.
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-scoped query key ['drives', vehicleId, 'history', boundedLimit]; limit clamped to 1-1000; enabled only for a vehicle; request receives AbortSignal; MODERATE stale time; safeArray selection. Page supplies no date bounds or pagination.
dataSources.backendUnknowns: Server ordering, completeness, in-progress inclusion and query filtering were not traced beyond route binding; no backend measurement semantics or runtime correctness claim.

dataSources.name: Selected vehicle
dataSources.behavior: Consume existing workspace vehicle selection; no second selector; missing selection returns NoVehicleSelected. Hook implementation not inspected.

dataSources.name: Persisted target
dataSources.behavior: Global localStorage key teslasync:efficiency-target:v1; default 160 Wh/km; finite-number fallback; cross-tab storage event; in-memory fallback on storage errors. Input accepts finite positive edits and converts Wh/mi back to Wh/km; persistence remains unchanged.

dataSources.name: Target summary
dataSources.behavior: Pure model over Drive energyUsedWh, distanceM and startTs; positive finite measured energy and >=1000 m qualify; invalid/future timestamps excluded. Browser-local Monday weeks, energy/distance weighting, completed-only grading/ranking/streaks, 10% near-miss band, trailing four-calendar-week weighted trend, nullable unknown consumption and hit rate, returned/eligible/excluded counts and cap indication.

dataSources.name: Display preferences and trust
dataSources.behavior: Existing useUnits, useNumberFormatting, formatDayKey and convertDistanceToSI; display-only distance/consumption conversion with locale and precision. Historical useDataState provides fatal versus refresh distinction; retained data stays rendered with StaleRefreshWarning.

components.props: PageLayout title/subtitle/query/contextActions; Grid default=1,xl=5,gap=4; FadeIn delays 0,0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2.
components.implementationScope: Shared implementations not rereviewed; preserve canonical contracts.

summary or section-specific arrays/consistency, targetWhPerKm where applicable, section state and optional className; methodology historyLimit.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Band labels and semantic Badge variants recur in RecentWeekScorecard.tsx:45-56 and WeeklyTargetChart.tsx:34-40. This is local domain duplication, not evidence for a new application-wide registry.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: If modernizing these owned dependencies, reuse a small domain band-label/variant helper while preserving active/ungraded differences and existing Badge semantics.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Distance-unit consumption scale and unit labels repeat useEfficiencyTargetDisplay.ts:15-20.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing domain display helper for target scale and labels; preserve saved Wh/km and current unit-switch behavior. No new conversion engine.

sourceEvidence: EfficiencyTargetPage.tsx:31,126-136,149-159 stacks sections by default and uses 3/2 and 2/3 spans only at xl.
GoalPulse.tsx:78 uses one-to-two columns at md; TargetMethodology.tsx:115 uses an lg two-track grid with an 18rem minimum secondary track.
RecentWeekScorecard.tsx:180 explicitly retains rank/week/consumption/status as mobile columns; gap/distance/drives must remain reachable through existing table details and export.
All three charts use ResponsiveContainer and heights 300/380/360.

issues.detail: interval=0 forces all seven localized weekday ticks within the smaller xl panel and narrow mobile chart. Methodology.tsx:117 also fixes three count tiles at all widths. Potential crowding, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Exercise all ten specified widths, allocated containers, long translations and 200% text. Use existing chart/layout options to reflow labels/tiles without losing data or accessible alternatives.

responsive.status: Source-only; no viewport or mobile runtime acceptance.

sourceEvidence: EfficiencyTargetPage.tsx:103-106 localizes the numeric control accessible name.
Named section/region labels and decorative aria-hidden icons are present in inspected domain sections.
EfficiencyTargetSectionBody.tsx:33-39 labels loading role=status; QueryError retains retry.
Charts expose ariaLabel and dataColumns; RecentWeekScorecard uses the canonical DataTable rather than raw table markup.

issues.detail: Empty, nonfinite and nonpositive edits return silently; min=1 does not provide application feedback or restore the persisted target display. An invalid typed value can disagree with the target still used in analysis.
issues.fix: Use existing Input feedback with localized validation and an explicit draft/committed-value policy; preserve positive target acceptance and saved canonical value.

states.initialLoading: sourceState.status=initial maps to section isLoading; section bodies show Skeleton, charts receive loading, summary suppresses unavailable evidence.
states.fatalError: sourceState.fatalError passed to sections; bodies/charts show QueryError and retry; summary exposes Source unavailable.
states.refreshErrorAndStale: Page retains history payload and summary with StaleRefreshWarning; summary brief receives retained boolean rather than dropping data.
states.empty: Individual chart, pulse, scorecard and methodology placeholders remain; summary empty action navigates to /drives. Empty consumption/hit rate are null, not zero.
states.noVehicle: NoVehicleSelected early return, preserving the hook's disabled query when vehicle absent.
states.partial: History cap disclosed, active week distinguished and ungraded, eligible/excluded counts shown. No independent additional query sources.
states.offline: No explicit page offline branch; shared query/layout/warning behavior not exercised.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / unknown is not completed evidence
issues.detail: Cap badge is outside EfficiencyTargetSectionBody. Before history arrives or during fatal failure, default empty summary yields 'Observed window below API cap'; this is not established source coverage.
issues.fix: Suppress the evidence assertion or label it pending/unavailable using existing state while preserving the badge and actual cap disclosure after data resolves.

issues.detail: Both NestedDrivingBrief calls omit existing retained prop, defaulting to false. During a refresh failure the page warning and main brief signal retained evidence while these nested briefs say Returned evidence.
issues.fix: Pass retained trust through the domain section state or props into existing NestedDrivingBrief.retained at both calls; do not discard usable data.

visualIssues.detail: One consumption series rotates every weekday through CHART_COLORS by index with opacity 0.78. This is a rainbow encoding without additional category semantics. Actual palette saturation and rendered contrast were not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Use one restrained existing series color for weekday consumption, keeping every category/value, target reference and accessible table. Preserve explicit saved chart palette preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Active-week panel fixes cyan-400 tinted border/background; TargetMethodology.tsx:152 fixes amber-400 tint even below the cap. These are low-opacity but page-local saturated-hue surfaces rather than canonical surface tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use current neutral surface/border tokens and reserve existing Badge semantics for active/warning meaning; only emphasize cap warnings when supported. Do not create shared palette variants.

architectureIssues.detail: Input is uncontrolled via defaultValue, keyed only by distanceUnit. useStoredNumber handles storage-event updates, but a changed target in another tab will update computations without synchronizing the mounted input's value.
architectureIssues.fix: Use a controlled draft synchronized with target and units, with localized validation and an explicit commit policy. Keep the storage key, default, positive-value rule, canonical Wh/km and unit preference unchanged.

architectureIssues.detail: nowMs is captured once per mount. summarizeTarget excludes drives later than nowMs and determines active week from it (efficiencyTarget.ts:180-187,224). Later refetched drives can be omitted and a long-lived mount crossing Monday can keep old completed/active classification.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve time freshness in the existing domain computation lifecycle on successful source updates and week rollover without changing local-week semantics or adding a competing clock/store. Validate deterministically.

priority.reason: Resolve uncontrolled saved-target mismatch, frozen analysis time and unsupported/contradictory trust labels before presentation acceptance; then reduce weekday rainbow and local tinted surfaces.
priority.scope: Source audit only. No implementation, source edits, runtime verification or migration-completion claim.

competingImplementations.assessment: Page already uses existing PageLayout/Grid, Input, chart frame, DataTable and OperationalBrief owners. Proposed fixes use existing props/helpers. No new shared component, theme, formatter, overlay or query store is warranted from this single page.
competingImplementations.unreviewed: Barrel exports EfficiencyTargetKpis, but only its type is referenced by the mounted brief; its implementation and other production consumers were not inspected. No speculative competing-owner conclusion.

Retry the drive history query from source error surfaces.

dataBehavior: Preserve selected vehicle, one capped 1000-row history request, existing keys/cancellation/stale policy; no silent claim of lifetime or full-window completeness.
Keep raw Drive meters and watt-hours intact; only display preferences convert values. Saved target remains Wh/km.
Retain positive measured-energy and >=1 km eligibility, timestamp filtering, local Monday-through-Sunday grouping, source-distance weighting and active-week exclusion.
Keep band thresholds, current/longest streak calculations, completed ranking, rolling four-calendar-week weighting and all metadata.

No automatic workspace range adoption: current page explicitly reports observed-history coverage, hook accepts no bounds, and scoped workspace registry search found no efficiency-target range entry. Any later range change is an integration decision, not a cosmetic rewrite.
Preserve loading, empty, fatal failure, retained refresh data, locale/precision, unit preferences, responsive spans and every section.
